text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The event Hokko Tarumae had worked toward 
concluded as a resounding success.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, most of the audience were locals 
from Tomakomai. Hokko Tarumae regrets that 
she couldn't attract visitors from outside 
the city.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she made the people of Tomakomai 
want to cheer for her, making the event a 
success. That served as proof that she was 
indeed Tomakomai's local idol.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the event. Smart Falcon 
suddenly announced that she wouldn't be 
entering races for a while, leaving Hokko 
Tarumae stunned. However—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking Smart Falcon's encouragement for 
dirt Umamusume to heart, Hokko Tarumae 
looked forward. Her next goal was the 
Leopard Stakes...!
